scenes.line1: What if the app is slow or flaky?
scenes.say: When things break, do you freeze, or do you have a plan? Let’s build your go-to playbook for those classic connectivity and latency issues.

scenes.label: Slow App
scenes.sub: Start by checking the load balancer for latency and errors, then look for a bad backend node.
scenes.say: If the app is slow for everyone, check the load balancer for latency spikes or errors. A single bad backend could be dragging it all down.

rows.b: Compare firewall rules by source subnet
Look for differences in network paths
See if address translation changes things

scenes.say: If it works from one place but not another, compare firewall rules, routes, and proxies between the two. Sometimes, it’s just a missing rule or a different path.

scenes.title: Large Uploads Fail
scenes.say: When large uploads fail but small ones work, check for MTU issues, body size limits on the load balancer, or timeouts on proxies.

scenes.question: App is slow after moving to cloud. Why?
scenes.right: High latency adds up if the app is chatty. Hundreds of queries times round trip equals big delays.
scenes.say: Here’s a classic trap: when an app slows down after moving to the cloud, don’t blame bandwidth right away. If the app makes lots of queries, high round trip times add up fast.
